title: trisetum aureum
intro: Trisetum aureum, commonly known as Golden Oat Grass, is a perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of China. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Trisetum aureum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. Regular consumption of Trisetum aureum has been reported to alleviate symptoms of bronchitis, cough, and sore throat, while also supporting overall well-being and respiratory health.
